app.title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
app.author: SpeakingOfBrad
app.description: A browser extension that turns any webpage into a sign by overlaying large text.
proposed_tests: Install extension from Chrome Web Store and enable on a test page
Navigate to a page containing short text and verify overlay renders correctly
Measure overlay rendering time for a page with 10k words
Check that the extension respects user-configured font size and color settings
